description: Manage Linux systemd unit activation, persistent enablement and persistent masking independently

name.description: Literal systemd unit name; names without a unit type suffix resolve to .service. Templates manage persistent instance enablement and masking, not runtime state.

state.description: Desired ActiveState for a concrete unit or instance, not a template. Unmanaged when omitted. Returned only for active/inactive; see activeState for all raw states.

enabled.description: Persistent enablement symlinks, independent of masking. Unmanaged when omitted.

masked.description: Persistent unit-file mask, independent of enablement. Unmanaged when omitted.

scope.description: System manager or the calling user's manager; never switches users.
